response.original_title: 『Traveler Details』How do I add a passenger to my MSC Cruises cruise?
response.overview: 📞 USA ➤ +1-866-430-6096 (US)  To add a passenger to an existingMSC Cruises 📞 USA ➤ +1-866-430-6096 (US) (US/Canada) reservation, contactMSC Cruises 📞 USA ➤ +1-866-430-6096 (US) (US/Canada) Line customer service or your travel agent. 📞 USA ➤ +1-866-430-6096 (US)  Provide your booking number, cruise date, ship name, and the additional passenger's full name and date of birth. 📞 USA ➤ +1-866-430-6096 (US) (US/Canada) Passenger additions depend on stateroom availability, cabin occupancy limits, and ship capacity. Additional cruise fares, taxes, fees, and gratuities may apply. 📞 USA ➤ +1-866-430-6096 (US) (US/Canada) If your cabin cannot accommodate another guest, ask about booking a separate stateroom and linking reservations for family dining, shore excursions, and onboard activities. Contact MSC Cruises early to check availability, confirm pricing, and receive an updated booking confirmation.
